name: Goblin Sponsorship
summary: Baron Revilgaz has the Fuel Regulator Blueprints ready and sends them to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats. He gives his regards and adds that Pozzik should not hesitate to ask if he ever needs anything.

sections.title: Regards for Pozzik
sections.body: Baron Revilgaz says you are all set. You carry the blueprints to Pozzik, out on the Shimmering Flats, with the Baron's regards and a message: if Pozzik ever needs anything, he should not hesitate to ask. Revilgaz says he will be waiting for news that Pozzik breaks the track record.

sections.title: Improving the Design
sections.body: Pozzik had hoped the regulator would already be assembled. Still, he sees a chance to improve the design from the ground up. He plans to sketch improved schematics, build the part and have it installed soon.

faq.q: Who sends you with the blueprints?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz sends you from Booty Bay, with his regards for Pozzik.

faq.q: Who receives the fuel regulator blueprints?
aliases: where do i take the blueprints

faq.q: What does Baron Revilgaz hope to hear?
faq.answer: He says he will be waiting for news that Pozzik breaks the track record.
It follows Goblin Sponsorship (4), in which you fetched the blueprints for Revilgaz. The next step is The Eighteenth Pilot.
